entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A Dominarian pit-fighter and dementia caster for the Cabal who found the Mirari and was consumed by its power.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The pit-fighting, dementia-casting power in Cabal City, ruled by the Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The city of the Cabal, near salt flats on Otaria.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: A powerful orb that shows visions of greatness and overwhelms its users.

entities.name: Minat
entities.description: An old, mostly-blind dementia caster who taught Chainer to pit fight and the Death Bloom spell.

entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: A senior dementia master who took a paternal role in training Chainer and was killed on the Patriarch's orders.

entities.name: The Patriarch
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal, nigh-immortal due to his pact with Kuberr.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A mountain barbarian warrior who befriends Chainer and finally kills him.

entities.name: Major Teroh
entities.description: An Order officer who fought Chainer and killed Skellum, later slaughtered by Chainer.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, a pit fighter who cost Chainer his right arm.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: Kamahl's mentor and a pit fighter who fought Chainer.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merfolk ambassador who made a deal with Chainer to create a champion.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: A champion created by Chainer with the Mirari for Laquatus.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The Cabal's god, whose pact makes the Patriarch nigh-immortal.

entities.name: Deidre
entities.description: Chainer's friend, a cabalist killed by Order troopers.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: The rival military order that attacks Cabal City.

entities.name: Death Bloom
entities.description: A powerful spell that Chainer uses to slay superior opponents.

events.summary: Chainer discovers the Mirari in a ruined manor's basement but resists its call, deciding it is fit only for the First of the Cabal.
events.quote: Chainer resisted its call, deciding that such power was only fit for the First of the Cabal.

events.summary: Chainer fights off Order guardsmen on his way to the Patriarch and earns the First's favor.
During a dragon attack on the city, Chainer defends the Mirari vaults and uses Death Bloom to shatter a golem and kill Order troops, after his friend Deidre dies.
events.quote: Chainer tapped into the ambient power of the Mirari and unleashed the Death Bloom spell, shattering the golem and killing the Order troops.

events.summary: Chainer loses his right arm to Jeska's explosive bolt in the pits and receives a golem arm paid for by Skellum.
events.quote: where he lost his right arm when he was hit by one of Jeska’s explosive bolts

events.summary: Chainer and Kamahl form a twelve-win pit partnership, broken when Kamahl refuses the First's order to throw a match.
events.quote: so he refused to fight and broke off their partnership

events.summary: The Patriarch arranges Skellum's death in a pit fight against an Order squad led by Teroh; Skellum passes his experience to Chainer so he can witness the betrayal, and Chainer swears revenge.
events.quote: Chainer was horrified by it and swore revenge against the squad.

events.summary: Chainer completes his shikar with Kamahl and sees a vision of Kuberr.
events.quote: He also saw a vision of the Cabal's god Kuberr

events.summary: Chainer fills the central arena with dementia beasts, routing the Order's attack; Kamahl is seriously injured.
events.quote: the Order broke off its attack and fled the city.

events.summary: To earn use of the Mirari, Chainer slaughters Teroh, his corps, wounded troops in a Samite hospital and many healers.
events.quote: slaughtering Teroh, his command corps, all the injured troops recovering in a Samite hospital, and most of the innocent healers as well.

events.summary: Chainer creates Burke for Laquatus and heals Kamahl with snakeskin; Kamahl burns his skin off, ruining their friendship.
events.quote: His refusal to accept the Cabal's gifts ruined his and Chainer's friendship.

events.summary: Chainer uses the Mirari to power a Death Bloom that kills the Patriarch's guards, forcing the Patriarch into exile in Aphetto, and takes control of Cabal City.
events.quote: he took control of Cabal City and, therefore, fulfilled the Mirari’s visions.

events.summary: At the Mirari games an Order justiciar and angels attack; infuriated, Chainer taps the dementia space of almost every caster on Otaria, unleashing carnage in Cabal City.
events.quote: brought all the creatures he found there into existence inside Cabal City.

events.summary: Kamahl confronts and fights Chainer, melting off his artificial arm; Chainer's healing goes wrong and the Mirari overwhelms him.
events.quote: the Mirari’s power finally overwhelmed him, replacing Chainer’s entire body with a writhing mass of dementia creatures.

events.summary: Chainer begs Kamahl to kill him, and Kamahl does; the Mirari passes to Kamahl.
events.quote: while the Mirari now passed on to Kamahl.

relations.quote: a dementia caster for the Cabal

relations.note: taught him pit fighting and Death Bloom
relations.quote: Chainer was taught how to pit fight by an old, mostly-blind dementia caster called Minat
with Skellum taking on a paternal role while teaching Chainer the art of dementia casting

relations.note: created with the Mirari for Laquatus
relations.quote: successfully used its power to create Burke for Laquatus
Chainer decided to use the Mirari to get revenge on the last remaining person responsible for Skellum’s death—the Patriarch himself.

relations.note: slaughtered him on the Patriarch's assignment
relations.quote: so Chainer carried out his assignment with relish
he gurgled (presumably) for Kamahl to kill him, who did so.

relations.note: agreement to create a champion; later Laquatus researches the Patriarch's name
relations.quote: He had made a deal with Laquatus to research the Patriarch’s secret name
